cause.recording_probe_failed: Recording pre-flight check failed at issuance
cause.recording_flush_failed: Failed to flush recording data to disk
cause.recording_resize_write_failed: Failed to write recording resize event
cause.recording_file_stat_failed: Could not confirm recording file on disk
cause.recording_file_missing: Recording file missing (write failed or recording never started)
cause.session_record_create_failed: Session record creation failed; connection refused
cause.audit_write_fallback_file: Audit batch write failed; fell back to file
cause.audit_write_batch_dropped: Audit batch write failed; file fallback disabled, batch dropped
cause.audit_write_sync_refused: Synchronous audit write failed; the operation was refused
cause.sensitive_reveal_alert_write_failed: Sensitive content access was audited, but its additional alert could not be written
cause.command_audit_write_refused: Synchronous statement record write failed; the statement was refused
cause.command_blocker_unavailable: The command blocking matcher is unavailable; the statement was refused
cause.aad_residue_impossible_state: Non-final-format ciphertext residue detected (impossible state: code defect or direct database write)
cause.checkpoint_anchor_dropped: Checkpoint off-box copy not sent (no off-box copy of that checkpoint)
cause.audit_chain_structure_invalid: Checkpoint chain structure anomaly (signature, linkage or sequence tampered)
cause.audit_chain_content_mismatch: Audit records in a notarized interval mismatch the checkpoint or are missing
cause.audit_chain_content_extra_rows: Extra records with valid row-level signatures found in a notarized interval (needs manual review)
cause.audit_chain_verify_failed: Chain verification itself could not complete (mechanism state unknown, not "no anomaly")
cause.source_policy_unreadable: Judgment point could not read the user's allowed source ranges
cause.source_policy_corrupt: The user's stored allowed source ranges cannot be parsed (direct DB write or program defect)
cause.offsite_upload_failed: Offsite upload has reached the retry limit (that evidence currently has only a local copy)
cause.offsite_upload_stalled: Offsite upload keeps being interrupted (the transfer lease for one object expired repeatedly)
cause.offsite_integrity_mismatch: A retrieved offsite copy did not match what was uploaded (delivery refused)
cause.role_state_mismatch: Role assignments do not match the checkpoint chain (a change was made without an audit record)
cause.principal_state_mismatch: Principal or credential state does not match the checkpoint chain (a change has no audit record)
cause.dek_unwrap_failed: Data key re-unwrap keeps failing (the key custodian is unreachable or refusing, so operations that need the key fail)

degraded.title: Degraded notification

rotation_report.appendix_b: Appendix B  Rotation records in period
rotation_report.caliber_a: Remaining days A = applicable days - whole days since the last successful rotation
rotation_report.caliber_b: Remaining days B = next scheduled run - as-of time, in whole days
rotation_report.caliber_due_soon: Due soon means remaining days A falls between zero and the warning window
rotation_report.caliber_no_record: No record means this system holds no successful rotation record; it does not mean the account was never rotated
rotation_report.caliber_population: The population is the asset accounts registered in this system; accounts existing only on the target host are not included
rotation_report.caliber_shared: Shared credential means the account logs in with a credential whose scope is shared in the credential library; every host attached to that credential logs in with its secret versions
rotation_report.footer_integrity: Integrity is established by the manifest and its signature
rotation_report.no_policy_lead: These accounts have no applicable age, so overdue cannot be determined; what needs attention is the policy setting, not the account owner
rotation_report.rate_counting_no_record: Compliance rate (no record counted as non-compliant)

rotation_report.truncation_records: Record rows truncated at the cap

alert_kind.new_source_ip: Account connected from a new source address
alert_kind.agent_breaker_tripped: Agent token suspended after repeated probing

alert_kind_text.audit_degraded: This input could not be reliably reconstructed as command text. Check the session recording for what actually happened.
alert_kind_text.new_source_ip: This is the account's first connection from this address. To confirm, review that day's records for this address.

degrade_reason.altscreen_round: The screen was inside a full-screen program at the time (such as an editor or pager).
degrade_reason.redraw_unanchored: The whole screen was redrawn, so the text on screen could not be matched to the input.
degrade_reason.fullscreen_input: These keystrokes went to a full-screen program.
degrade_reason.queue_discarded: Input not yet matched could no longer be matched when the screen was redrawn.
degrade_reason.queue_discarded_at_close: Input not yet matched could no longer be matched when the connection ended.
degrade_reason.queue_uncounted: Input not yet matched could no longer be matched, and the actual number of inputs may be higher than recorded.
degrade_reason.queue_overflow: Pending input reached its limit, and later input was not queued for matching.
degrade_reason.input_without_echo: Input was sent, but the output contains no text that can be reconstructed. If the remote side turned off echo, the recording will not show it either.
degrade_reason.input_without_command: This connection received input, but no command could be reconstructed from it.

compliance_report.title: Compliance Mapping Report
compliance_report.scope_statement: This report shows how the security settings covered by this policy group compared with its clauses at the data-as-of time, and separately lists the clauses carried by the product that have no adjustable setting. "Compliant" means a setting value meets the clause's requirement. It does not mean the organization has completed an overall compliance assessment against the standard. Procedures, people and controls in other systems are outside the scope of this report.
compliance_report.unmapped_line: {n} other settings are not covered by this group.
compliance_report.builtin_lead: The clauses below are carried by the product's own mechanisms and have no adjustable setting, so this report does not compare any setting against them.
compliance_report.builtin_empty: This group has no clauses carried by the product.
compliance_report.self_attested_lead: Explained by the organization. The system does not judge these clauses.
compliance_report.appendix_a: Appendix A: every clause and setting
compliance_report.result_self_attested: Explained by the organization, not judged by the system
compliance_report.result_builtin: Carried by the product, no adjustable setting
compliance_report.caliber_body: For every clause, the settings it points to are compared against the value the clause asks for. When a clause asks for something without naming a value, the system only lists the current value and leaves the judgement to the auditor. Organization notes never change a result.
compliance_report.reason_disabled_by_zero: 0 turns this off, which does not meet the requirement
compliance_report.reason_disabled_by_zero_retention: 0 means records are kept forever with no set retention limit; this group requires a set limit
compliance_report.reason_value_not_comparable: The current value cannot be compared with the requirement
compliance_report.reason_reference_value_unconfirmed: This group gives a reference value; your organization has not confirmed it
compliance_report.reason_reference_value_confirmed: This group gives a reference value; your organization has confirmed it
compliance_report.reason_expectation_unspecified: Required but no value is named; an auditor judges it
compliance_report.reason_no_control: This group does not cover this setting
compliance_report.footer_integrity: Integrity is established by the manifest and its signature
